connector.name: AIOProductOS MCP
connector.registryDescription: AIOProductOS: revenue, feedback, work and analytics on one customer record. 71 tools, 3 apps.
connector.summary: Hosted at platform.aioproductos.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.aioproductos, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PRODUCTOS_TOKEN
env.description: AIOProductOS personal access token (Settings → Tokens & Agents).
